                [32m'  sort or limit present on the load query;\n'[39m +
                [32m'* a thread with no matching message must still be present in the result with `[]`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### 3. Relationship `ancestor_messages` on `ThreadGraph.Forum.Message`\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'A public `has_many`-style relationship to `ThreadGraph.Forum.Message` named `ancestor_messages`,\n'[39m +
                [32m'implemented by the module `ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.AncestorMessages`, reported by\n'[39m +
                [32m'`Ash.Resource.Info.relationship/2` the same way as above.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Contract, for each source message independently:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* the value is the transitive chain of parents reached by repeatedly following `parent_id`;\n'[39m +
                [32m'* ordering is outermost ancestor **first**, the immediate parent **last**;\n'[39m +
                [32m'* the source message itself is never included, and no message appears twice;\n'[39m +
                [32m'* traversal must terminate on a cyclic `parent_id` chain: stop as soon as the next hop is a message\n'[39m +
                [32m'  that has already been collected or is the source message itself;\n'[39m +
                [32m'* a message with `parent_id == nil` must be present in the result with `[]`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### 4. Relationship `linked_messages` on `ThreadGraph.Forum.Message`\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'A public `has_many`-style relationship to `ThreadGraph.Forum.Message` named `linked_messages`,\n'[39m +
                [32m'implemented by the module `ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.LinkedMessages`, reported by\n'[39m +
                [32m'`Ash.Resource.Info.relationship/2` the same way as above.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Contract, for each source message independently:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* consider the directed graph whose edges are the `ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink` records, pointing\n'[39m +
                [32m'  from `from_message_id` to `to_message_id`, **regardless of `kind`**;\n'[39m +
                [32m'* the value is every message reachable from the source message in one or more hops;\n'[39m +
                [32m'* each reachable message appears exactly once and is associated with its **minimum** hop distance\n'[39m +

                [32m'* ordering: minimum hop distance **ascending**, then `position` **ascending**, then `id`\n'[39m +

                [32m'* a message with no outgoing edge must be present in the result with `[]`.\n'[39m +

                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Define the **endorsement count** of a message `M` as the number of `ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink`\n'[39m +
